## What SpecKit Product Forge is good at

SpecKit Product Forge (VaiYav) is a open source offering in the spec-driven-development category. In short: Spec Kit extension adding product discovery, product-spec, and pre-implementation design/architecture/risk review gates before coding.

It is a direct alternative on this axis: teams can seriously consider it as a primary tool for overlapping work.

Public positioning and our competitive notes: Explicit pre-impl review gate aligns with Spec Review intent; agent/plugin UX, not multi-tenant review platform.

AI is accelerating how fast software changes. EasySpecs helps teams share a trustworthy product story—document the real system, polish intent, and trust specs before the next change lands.

Software is changing faster than teams can keep a shared understanding of what they already built. Coding agents multiply that speed. Without a living source of truth for intent and how the system works today, every change is a guess.

EasySpecs is the Spec Review Platform for that gap.
